_comment: Files still carrying theme-blind `*-gray-N` Tailwind literals, as of #620. This is the repo's theme-token debt ledger, not an ignore-list to grow: `src/__tests__/theme/core-authoring-pages-tokens.test.ts` fails when any file not listed here gains a gray literal, and when a listed file exceeds its allowance for any single literal. Counts are per distinct literal, not one total per file, so swapping one shade for another (text-gray-500 -> text-gray-300) fails rather than netting out. Dropping a count does NOT fail — shrink these freely, and delete the entry when it empties. Never raise a count to make CI pass; use a theme token (text-foreground / text-muted-foreground / bg-muted / border-border) instead.
